author: tookadayoff
body: Chat noir follower if you’re valhallan and don’t have arisen spirit garm

author: Visible-Celery27
body:
Well, everything besides skins you can farm eventually.

So I would say interesting things are (order depends on you):
- limited time follower if you don't have the "normal" equivalent follower 
- limited time skins in general (if you are into that)
- archpath if you want to boost farming a specific event

author: StraightG0lden
body: I personally like the archpaths as long as you're able to finish them for the unlocks

author: GallusWrangler
body: That’s one of the beauts of Orna. Purchases are either cosmetic or can be obtained otherwise through perseverance.

author: Widogeist
body: Besides the various character and town cosmetics, galar hammers are nice for faster blacksmith upgrades, although they can be farmed with end of dungeon rewards once you unlock it through the main story quests. Additional equipment sets are a huge QoL. Realmcrystals could be nice to have for the Arisen Waygate events incase you get kicked out so you don't have to wait for the cooldown period. Then there's literally the "coffee" item in the runeshop which is basically just giving money to the game developer to help support it. They also have a [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/northernforge).

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Archpaths are generally worthwhile, especially the first time through. 

Otherwise, you'll get the most use out of skins for your favorite classline! Everything else is consumable or a badge you'll never see. The sprites Covyn makes are great :)

author: Forsaken_Republic_72
body:
Best value is undoubtedly the archpath. Or the lesser special packs for each event. They both have some nice items. 

Especially the beguiled archpath is worth it since it has 15 distorted mnemonic, which require quite a lot of farm to get. 

*- Isn’t really pay-to-win -* slowly getting there.
